If Orlando does both, the premise `(p_2(Orlando) ⊕ p_11(Orlando))` would be false, making the entire implication true, which might not be the intended meaning of the natural language statement. If the natural language intended an inclusive OR, the FOL should have been `(p_2(Orlando) ∨ p_11(Orlando)) → p_15(Orlando)`.
